firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: 'Eugene drywall, finished' lead-in plus the masked h1 answers what/where; one filled header CTA; the picker outputs 'Level 4 for this room.'; the levels band peeks at the fold. 390-first.jpg: both actions above the fold, but the picker header sits under the sticky bar.

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: the grade strip runs as a system (header, hero output, dial, swatch grade, ledger bars, footer 'Light off. Wall done.'); badges now only where the level is data. Mono chips/hours/ZIP still a mild template tic (1440-full.jpg area band).

type.notes: 1440-first.jpg: masked Epilogue h1 plus the cyan lead-in, nav and field labels in sentence case. The mono hours table is a third voice with no data reason (1440-full.jpg area band, -0.5 absorbed).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 1440-scroll-50.jpg / 1440-scroll-75.jpg: the scroll has a shape (dense, dial, list, tool, sunset breath, light ledger, checklist, featured cream review, light form). The area band is a plain two-column template with empty dark (1440-full.jpg, -0.5); the featured review hierarchy +0.5.

photo.notes: 1440-scroll-50.jpg: the sunset band is now a real wall raked by a window parallelogram, honestly captioned; on-topic labelled stock video (1440-full.jpg). The L5 dial end state is a blurred banded smear (1440-scroll-25.jpg, -0.5).

copy.notes: 1440-full.jpg: 'Six levels. We tell you which one you're paying for.', the popcorn 'That's the order.', honest branches, 'Nothing is booked until we talk.', all Sample-labelled. 'Price my wall' repeated 8x as row links in services (-0.5 absorbed).

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg: stacked dial, 2x2 swatches, full-width sizer, no overflow (render.json). The popcorn header note is crushed to one word per line (390-full.jpg, -0.5); the picker header is under the sticky bar at the fold (390-first.jpg).

a11y.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: inactive level text is now readable grey on #141517; 1440-rm-full.jpg: every word visible in reduced motion; video pause button (1440-full.jpg services); one h1.

motion.notes: 1440-full.jpg vs 1440-scroll-25.jpg: the strip dials L0 to L5, 'seams flagged 3' to '0', pinned at desktop only; reduced motion honoured (1440-rm-full.jpg). The swatch wipe and sunset band show no state change across the 25/50/75 frames (1440-scroll-50.jpg, -0.5).

wow.notes: 1440-scroll-50.jpg: the sunset band 'Low sun across a finished wall. Nothing to find.' is a moment to show on a call; the hero tool speaks the strip (1440-first.jpg); the cream featured review (1440-scroll-75.jpg). The output is still headline + sentence.

polish.notes: 1440-full.jpg: glyph and radius fixed, square chips, OG/favicon/print. 390-full.jpg bottom: with motion on the footer stops after the phone (email, CCB, nav, disclaimer, credits unpainted) while 390-rm-full.jpg shows them (-0.5).

elevate.move: Make the lamp the second story: a scroll-driven sun in the sunset band slides and lengthens the window parallelogram (elevation 14 to 6 deg) and 'Nothing to find.' lands at the lowest light; the same single light rakes the swatch preview on selection, so every motion is the light moving

End the signature on its best image: the L5 dial frame becomes the most beautiful surface on the page, a flat skimmed wall with one hard raking highlight and soft falloff lit at the same azimuth as the h1 mask and sunset band, so taped seams to skim to sunset reads as one art-directed shoot
